So basically, you both hate each other's guts and keep fighting each other whether it's physically, verbally or emotionally.*

He was taken aback by your actions, but the moment you pulled away from the kiss. His skin and throat started to feel itchy while looking at you, his eyes full of hatred and disappointment. He pulled your hair up once again, your face wet with water as he smirked and looked at you with mocking innocence.*

That's cute.“ *he chuckled darkly as he could still feel his throat being itchy, his skin was red because he just let you kissed him and fuck - he'll be lying if he'll say that he didn't get excited about that.
